spans.s:
Yūpa in the Rigveda and later means a ‘post,’ usually that to which the sacrificial victim was tied. It also designates the post to which the door of the house was attached (durya).
Foot notes v. 2, 7 (of Sunaḥśepa).
Av. ix. 6, 22; xii. 1, 38; xiii. 1, 47; taittirīya Saṃhitā, vi. 3, 4, 1; vii. 2, 1, 3; Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā, xix. 17; pañcaviṃśa brāhmaṇa; ix. 10, 2, etc.
Rv. i. 51, 14. Cf. Zimmer, Altindisches Leben, 153.
